chunks.en: I'm still setting up my desk.
accept: I am still setting up my desk.
chunks.note: 說事情還沒做完。set up 是「擺好、布置好」，still 放在 be 動詞後面。

distractors.text: I still setting up my desk.
I'm still set up my desk.
I'm still seting up my desk.

chunks.en: Where do you keep the pens and folders?
chunks.zh: 筆和資料夾都放在哪裡？
chunks.note: 問東西平常收在哪裡。keep 在這裡是「存放、收著」。

distractors.text: Where you keep the pens and folders?
Where do you keeps the pens and folders?
Where do you keep the pens and foldres?

chunks.en: It's my first time using this machine.
accept: It is my first time using this machine.
chunks.note: 第一次做某件事：It's my first time＋V-ing。

distractors.text: It's my first time to using this machine.
It's my first time use this machine.
It's my first time using this machin.

chunks.en: Can I watch you do it once?
chunks.zh: 我可以先看你做一次嗎？
chunks.note: 請對方先示範一次。watch＋人＋動詞原形 = 看某人做。

distractors.text: Can I watch you to do it once?
Can I watching you do it once?
Can I watch you do once?

chunks.en: Is there someone who can fix my monitor?
chunks.zh: 有沒有人可以幫我修螢幕？
chunks.note: 關係子句：someone who can… = 可以……的人，who 接著說這個人會做什麼。

distractors.text: Is there someone can fix my monitor?
Is there someone which can fix my monitor?
Is there someone who can fixes my monitor?

chunks.en: Is she the woman who works at the front desk?
chunks.zh: 她是櫃台的那位小姐嗎？
chunks.note: the woman who works… 用 who 說明是哪一位；她一個人，動詞加 s。

distractors.text: Is she the woman who work at the front desk?
Is she the woman works at the front desk?
Is she woman who works at the front desk?

chunks.en: Which bin do paper cups go in?
accept: What bin do paper cups go in?
chunks.note: 問東西要丟哪裡。go in 的 in 留在句尾。

distractors.text: Which bin paper cups go in?
Which bin does paper cups go in?
Which bin do paper cup go in?

chunks.zh: 對了，你週末過得怎麼樣？
chunks.note: 星期一跟同事閒聊的開場。So 用來換話題，週末過去了所以用 was。

distractors.text: So, how were your weekend?
So, how was your weekends?
So, how your weekend was?

chunks.en: Do you guys usually eat in the cafeteria?
chunks.zh: 你們平常都在員工餐廳吃嗎？
chunks.note: you guys 是口語的「你們」；平常的習慣用現在式，usually 放在動詞前。

distractors.text: Do you guys eat usually in the cafeteria?
Does you guys usually eat in the cafeteria?
Do you guys usually eat in cafeteria?

chunks.en: Do you want me to sort these by date?
chunks.zh: 要我把這些照日期排好嗎？
chunks.note: want＋人＋to＋動詞：Do you want me to…? = 要我幫你……嗎？

distractors.text: Do you want me sort these by date?
Do you want I to sort these by date?
Do you want me to sorting these by date?

chunks.en: Ms. Carter asked me to scan all of these.
chunks.zh: Ms. Carter 要我把這些全部掃描。
chunks.note: ask＋人＋to＋動詞：asked me to… = 叫我去做……，asked 是過去式。

distractors.text: Ms. Carter asked me scan all of these.
Ms. Carter asked me to scanned all of these.
Ms. Carter asked to me scan all of these.

chunks.en: I followed the steps, but nothing happened.
chunks.zh: 我照著步驟做了，可是沒反應。
chunks.note: 說你照做了卻沒用。but 連接兩件事，兩邊都是過去式。

distractors.text: I followed the steps, but nothing happen.
I followed the steps, but nothing was happened.
I followed the steps, but nothing happend.

chunks.en: Sure, I'd be happy to help with that.
accept: Sure, I would be happy to help with that.
chunks.note: 答應幫忙的客氣說法。I'd = I would，be happy to＋動詞原形。

distractors.text: Sure, I'd be happy to helping with that.
Sure, I'd happy to help with that.
Sure, I'd be hapy to help with that.

chunks.en: I'm not sure, but I'll find out.
accept: I am not sure, but I will find out.
chunks.note: 不知道答案時先說實話，再說會去查。find out = 查清楚。

distractors.text: I not sure, but I'll find out.
I'm not sure, but I'll finding out.
I'm not shure, but I'll find out.

words.zh: 用品（office supplies 辦公用品）

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Morning! So, how do you like your new desk?
scene.zh: 早安！你覺得新座位怎麼樣？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'm still setting up my desk.
scene.zh: 我還在整理座位。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Take your time. At least you have more space than me.
scene.zh: 慢慢來。至少你的位子比我的大。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Need anything? Just ask.
scene.zh: 需要什麼嗎？儘管說。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Where do you keep the pens and folders?
scene.zh: 筆和資料夾都放在哪裡？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Here, take a pen. There are more in my top drawer.
scene.zh: 來，先拿一支筆。我最上面的抽屜裡還有很多。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: The folders are in the cabinet by the window.
scene.zh: 資料夾在窗戶旁邊的櫃子裡。

fills.en: The ___ for the copier is in the top drawer.
fills.zh: 影印機的使用手冊在最上面的抽屜裡。
fills.note: 放在抽屜裡、教你怎麼用的是 manual（使用手冊）。

fills.en: The copier has no paper. Please bring me fifty ___.
fills.zh: 影印機沒紙了。請拿五十張紙給我。
fills.note: 影印機缺的是紙，fifty sheets = 五十張紙。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Do you need help with the copier?
scene.zh: 影印機要幫忙嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: It's my first time using this machine.
scene.zh: 我第一次用這台機器。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: No problem. First, turn on the power, right here.
scene.zh: 沒問題。先打開電源，在這裡。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: It has a fax function too, but we never use it.
scene.zh: 它也有傳真功能，不過我們從來不用。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Can I watch you do it once?
scene.zh: 我可以先看你做一次嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Sure. Put your sheets in here and push the green button.
scene.zh: 好啊。把紙放進這裡，再按綠色的按鈕。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: There's a manual in the top drawer, too.
scene.zh: 最上面的抽屜裡也有使用手冊。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: What's wrong? Is your screen black again?
scene.zh: 怎麼了？你的螢幕又黑掉了嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Is there someone who can fix my monitor?
scene.zh: 有沒有人可以幫我修螢幕？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Sure, a technician comes in every Thursday. Nice guy.
scene.zh: 有啊，每個星期四會有技術人員來。人很好。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: But check the cable in the back first.
scene.zh: 不過先看看後面的線。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: You can ask Kate for a new one. She manages the printer paper, too.
scene.zh: 你可以跟 Kate 要一條新的。印表機的紙也是她在管。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Is she the woman who works at the front desk?
scene.zh: 她是櫃台的那位小姐嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: That's her. My favorite coworker, but don't tell anyone.
scene.zh: 就是她。我最喜歡的同事，不過別跟別人說喔。

passages.title: MEMO
lines: The kitchen is a shared space. Please follow these rules:
1. The refrigerator is small. Put your name on your food. Perhaps you forgot something in there? We throw away old food every Friday afternoon.
2. Clean your cups and forks right away.
3. Turn off all appliances at the end of the day.
4. Please recycle. Bottles go in the blue bin. Paper goes in the green bin.

questions.en: When is old food thrown away?
questions.zh: 舊的食物什麼時候會被丟掉？

questions.en: What should people do at the end of the day?
questions.zh: 下班的時候大家要做什麼？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: So, did you see Ms. Reed's memo on the refrigerator?
scene.zh: 欸，你有看到 Ms. Reed 貼在冰箱上的公告嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: She's serious. Old food goes in the trash every Friday.
scene.zh: 她是認真的。每個星期五舊的食物都會被丟掉。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Which bin do paper cups go in?
scene.zh: 紙杯要丟哪一個桶子？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good question. The memo doesn't say.
scene.zh: 問得好。公告上沒寫。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Most people put them in the green bin, but that's wrong.
scene.zh: 大部分的人都丟綠色的桶子，可是那樣不對。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: There's plastic inside, so we can't recycle them.
scene.zh: 紙杯裡面有一層塑膠，所以不能回收。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Just throw them in the trash can under the sink.
scene.zh: 丟到水槽下面的垃圾桶就好。

fills.en: My friend Dan usually ___ lunch at noon.
fills.zh: 我的朋友 Dan 通常中午吃午餐。
fills.note: 每天的習慣用現在式，Dan 一個人，動詞加 s。

fills.en: I ___ a sandwich from home yesterday.
fills.zh: 我昨天從家裡帶了一個三明治。
fills.note: yesterday 是過去的事，用過去式 brought。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Lunch time! Is anyone using the microwave right now?
scene.zh: 午餐時間到了！現在有人在用微波爐嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: So, how was your weekend?
scene.zh: 對了，你週末過得怎麼樣？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Pretty good. My family and I tried somewhere new for dinner.
scene.zh: 還不錯。我跟家人去了一家新的店吃晚餐。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: What about you? What are you doing for lunch today?
scene.zh: 那你呢？你今天午餐要怎麼解決？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Do you guys usually eat in the cafeteria?
scene.zh: 你們平常都在員工餐廳吃嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Sometimes. It's not ours. Every company in the park uses it.
scene.zh: 有時候。那不是我們公司的，園區裡每家公司都可以用。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: But today I brought mine from home.
scene.zh: 不過我今天是自己從家裡帶。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Want some? There are paper plates in the top drawer.
scene.zh: 要不要吃一點？最上面的抽屜裡有紙盤。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Look at this pile of old project records.
scene.zh: 你看這一大疊舊的專案紀錄。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Do you want me to sort these by date?
scene.zh: 要我把這些照日期排好嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Yes, please. One clip for each month.
scene.zh: 好，麻煩你了。每個月用一個夾子。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: They go in the third section of that cabinet.
scene.zh: 它們放在那個櫃子的第三格。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Wait, what's all that on your desk?
scene.zh: 等等，你桌上那些是什麼？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Ms. Carter asked me to scan all of these.
scene.zh: Ms. Carter 要我把這些全部掃描。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: All of them? Remind me to buy you coffee.
scene.zh: 全部？提醒我要請你喝咖啡。

lines.en: So the problem is the system, not my computer?
lines.zh: 所以問題出在系統，不是我的電腦？

lines.en: Right. Wait a minute. The technician put in new software yesterday.
lines.zh: 對。等一下。技術人員昨天裝了新的軟體。

lines.en: New software? Do we need new passwords?
lines.zh: 新的軟體？我們要換新密碼嗎？

lines.en: Yes. Our old logins don't work now. Every user has to enter a new password.
lines.zh: 對。我們舊的帳號現在都不能用了，每個使用者都要輸入新密碼。

lines.en: Can you do that for me?
No, only he can. I'll call him and ask him to come at two.
lines.zh: 不行，只有他可以。我打給他，請他兩點過來。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: So, are you in the order system yet?
scene.zh: 欸，你登進訂單系統了嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I followed the steps, but nothing happened.
scene.zh: 我照著步驟做了，可是沒反應。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Let's check the easy stuff first. Is the power cable in the outlet?
scene.zh: 先從簡單的看起。電源線有插在插座上嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Yes, it is. And the internet is working, too.
scene.zh: 有，插著。網路也是通的。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Okay, so it's not your computer.
scene.zh: 好，所以不是你電腦的問題。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Every user has an individual login. Let me try mine.
scene.zh: 每個使用者都有自己的帳號。我用我的試試看。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Mine doesn't work. I'm not good with technology either.
scene.zh: 我的也不行。我對科技也不太在行。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I order our office supplies every month. Can you take it over?
scene.zh: 辦公用品一直是我每個月在訂。你可以接手嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Sure, I'd be happy to help with that.
scene.zh: 好啊，我很樂意幫忙。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Thanks! Only order what's essential. Don't waste money.
scene.zh: 謝啦！只訂必要的東西就好，別浪費錢。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: First question: do we have enough ink?
scene.zh: 第一個問題：墨水還夠嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'm not sure, but I'll find out.
scene.zh: 我不確定，我去問清楚。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Great. We normally order two ink cartridges a month.
scene.zh: 好。我們通常一個月訂兩個墨水匣。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And no pressure. Ask Kate for advice.
scene.zh: 還有，別有壓力。可以問 Kate 的建議。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Morning! Your desk looks really different.
scene.zh: 早安！你的座位看起來差好多。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'm still setting up my desk.
scene.zh: 我還在整理座位。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Looks good. Did you get into the new system?
scene.zh: 看起來不錯。你登進新系統了嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I followed the steps, but nothing happened.
scene.zh: 我照著步驟做了，可是沒反應。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: The technician gave everyone a new login. Nobody told you?
scene.zh: 技術人員給每個人一個新帳號。沒人跟你說嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Here's yours. Is your computer okay now?
scene.zh: 這是你的。你的電腦現在沒問題了嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Is there someone who can fix my monitor?
scene.zh: 有沒有人可以幫我修螢幕？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Sure. He comes in every Thursday.
scene.zh: 有啊。他每個星期四都會來。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Can you send a fax for me? The copier does it.
scene.zh: 你可以幫我傳真嗎？影印機就可以傳。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Can I watch you do it once?
scene.zh: 我可以先看你做一次嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Of course. Watch. Put the sheet here, and... done!
scene.zh: 當然。你看，把紙放這裡，然後……好了！

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Finished your coffee? Don't leave the cup on your desk.
scene.zh: 咖啡喝完了嗎？杯子別留在桌上喔。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Which bin do paper cups go in?
scene.zh: 紙杯要丟哪一個桶子？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: The trash can. We can't recycle those.
scene.zh: 丟垃圾桶。那種不能回收。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: So, how was your weekend?
scene.zh: 對了，你週末過得怎麼樣？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Great! We went somewhere new for dinner.
scene.zh: 很棒！我們去了一家新的店吃晚餐。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: One more thing. Do we have enough ink?
scene.zh: 還有一件事。墨水還夠嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'm not sure, but I'll find out.
scene.zh: 我不確定，我去問清楚。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Thanks. And what's that big pile on your desk?
scene.zh: 謝啦。對了，你桌上那一大疊是什麼？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Ms. Carter asked me to scan all of these.
scene.zh: Ms. Carter 要我把這些全部掃描。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: All of them? I'll make a fresh pot of coffee, then.
scene.zh: 全部？那我去煮一壺新的咖啡。
